items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Bass Shade played, when they playing Clannaddy, you could hear him down 31st Street, five blocks off.

ctx.x: The doors was wide open in the summertime. Bass Shade played, when they playing Clannaddy, you could hear him down 31st Street, five blocks off. I'm not lying to you. Because they had the windows open, you know. Yeah.
Was Bix playing good at that time? Oh, heck yes.
